officialEditorial.verifiedScope: Equal answer sums identify levels and equal-level left-count differences count better objects between endpoints. Official efficient 4759-query assertion is present, but its exact omitted implementation/proof remains unreconstructed. This review verifies the separate complete deterministic 4779 procedure.

mathematicalReview.obligation: Integer rank multiplicities and global thresholds
mathematicalReview.conclusion: At most five kinds follows from the minimum chain 1,2,5,26,677,458330. Every nonlast multiplicity c satisfies c+c^2+1<=200000, hence c<=446. Its preceding bounds are21 and4; S<=472 and noncheapest reply sum<=26. Fewer kinds have no larger bounds. These are universal over every legal transcript completion, not sample maxima.

A reply sum>26 proves a cheapest position in every completion, fixing S. Earlier prefix positions then all have sum<S. Otherwise 473 distinct known positions include a cheapest in every completion because S<=472; their fixed maximum reply sum equals S<=26 in every surviving completion. Shorter complete prefixes must encounter the unique best.

Reply sum1 means there is exactly one strictly better object, necessarily the unique type1. A subsequent sum1 correctly halves the remaining candidate interval via its 0/1 counts; a greater sum aborts that path and discards no candidates in the general restart. Total logical visits at most 1+bit_width(N-1)<=19.

A frame stores exact rare counts a/b outside [l,r], so k=S-a-b. After q consecutive rare midpoint positions, a cheapest reply(L,R) gives children kL=L-a-q and kR=R-b and outside pairs (a,R+q)/(L,b). Reaching the end gives only the left child (a,b+q); consuming all k leaves no rare unqueried position. Scanned positions are excluded from both children, and the best cannot disappear from all active frames without being queried.

mathematicalReview.obligation: D_H(k) full induction and prefix absorption
mathematicalReview.conclusion: For k>=2^(H-1), D_H(k)=2^H-1 dominates unique position visits. Otherwise combine min(u,x)+min(u,y)<=min(2u,x+y) over child levels to get q+1+D_(H-1)(x)+D_(H-1)(y)<=q+D_H(k-q)<=D_H(k). All-k-consumed and right-end-without-common cases satisfy their separate bounds. Children have length<=floor(parent/2). D18(472)=4759; early prefix c+1 is absorbed by reducing remaining rare count to S-c, totaling<=4760. Full473 prefix with S<=26 costs<=842. Add19 fast visits:4779<5000.

No proof step chooses one fixed hidden array. The threshold, fixed S and every outside count are invariants shared by all currently consistent legal completions; later replies can only narrow that family. A returned sum0 position is best in every final completion. Cache reuse preserves that exact prior reply and sends no duplicate external query.

implementationReview.originalAdapter: PRIZE_ORIGINAL_GRADER includes distributed prize.h, implements global int find_best(int), validates ask vector length2. Generic standalone and synthetic-header adapter are tested separately.
implementationReview.inputValidation: N3..200000, budget0..10000 and nonempty Oracle are validated before core allocations or questions. New external questions check budget before callback; detected local reply/classification/capacity contradictions throw runtime_error. Arbitrary dishonest oracles are not promised complete verification.
implementationReview.integerSafety: Range checks bound each reply component before adding it, so sums are <=N-1 even for rejected malformed responses. All internal indices, halves, outside sums, small counts and budgets stay safely in int. No public exploration computes rank-count squares.
implementationReview.exceptionsAndState: Callback/allocation exceptions propagate; API owns only local vectors and a value Result and retains no callback reference. Previous external effects are not rolled back. Nested calls, result mutation/copy/move and repeated calls cannot affect another invocation.
implementationReview.resources: O(N+Q) local time, excluding oracle evaluation; O(N+logN) storage. Cache is N Reply objects, iterative pending stack reserves32 frames and contains<=18. Search itself makes no allocation after reserve, independently fault-tested.
implementationReview.queryUpperBoundHelper: min(N,4761+bit_width(N-1)) is valid: global prefix+search<=4760 and fast<=1+bit_width(N-1); caching also bounds asks byN. Whole legal source range is covered.

reproducedAuthorChecker.scope: Reproduction, not new oracle coverage. Both original published-fence binaries were recompiled unchanged. All deterministic fields including complete maximumCases arrays match author sidecar; only timings/RSS differ.
reproducedAuthorChecker.leakSanitizer: detect_leaks=0 exactly as author checker; ASan and UBSan halt_on_error=1

additionalIndependentVerification.exactVisitRecurrence: All N1..255 and k1..N (32640 states), every capacity-feasible midpoint right scan length and left/right remaining marked split, including all-consumed/end branches. This independent DP does not assume a balanced split or use sampled binary shapes; its exact worst visits never exceed D_bitwidth(N)(k).
additionalIndependentVerification.adaptiveFamilies: 12 adaptive runs with three answer-bucket policies on four exact full-completion families: N80/S3, N200000/S3, N200000/S34, N200000/S472. Variable rank1/rank2 positions enumerate all size3 subsets among20 slots with each best, or all size5 subsets among15 slots with each best; other required ranks are fixed. Every candidate is an entire legal sequence and each reply retains a nonempty compatible set. Initial family occurrences75825 (25275 unique across four families, repeated across3 policies); 6216314 candidate reply evaluations. Every final completion has the returned best. This is supplementary large-domain adversarial testing, not exhaustive traversal of all large legal transcripts.
additionalIndependentVerification.allocationAndCallbackFaults: Two core allocation points (cache before first callback and pending reserve after prefix) independently throw a custom std::bad_alloc subtype; identical exception type propagates and live-byte count returns to baseline. Fresh recovery calls work. All3967 individual callback points on one maximum-domain S472 case throw the identical marker pointer and make no following ask. After reserve, forcing every further allocation to fail still permits a successful complete search with no allocation attempt.
additionalIndependentVerification.sanitizerEnvironment: Initial independent-harness LeakSanitizer attempt reported unsupported ptrace environment; rerun uses detect_leaks=0 as the published checker. Address/undefined checks pass; allocated live bytes are separately asserted for injected-failure unwinding.
